months.2: Snowpack is at its deepest and the park is cold. Snowshoes and groomed winter trails remain the options around the geyser basins.
months.12: Winter snow settles in across the park. Walkers stick to snowshoe routes and groomed trails near the geyser basins.

yosemite.overview: Yosemite offers granite and waterfall hiking in a class of its own. The valley features the steep Mist Trail to Vernal and Nevada Falls, while the famous Half Dome cables require a lottery permit and a big day of climbing. High-country trails off Tioga Road lead to alpine lakes and sweeping domes. The best access runs from June to October when the high passes are clear of snow.

months.1: The high country is buried in snow and closed to vehicles. Valley trails offer winter walking and snowshoeing, though paths are often icy.
months.5: The Mist Trail is powerful and drenched in spray. The Half Dome cables typically go up late in the month, opening the summit to permit holders, while the high-country trails still hold snow.
months.9: Cooler temperatures and clear trails make this an excellent month for long day hikes. The Half Dome cables are open, and the high-country routes are free of snow and insects.
months.11: Tioga Road usually closes for the winter, cutting off the high country. Hiking is restricted to the valley floor, where trails are increasingly icy.

months.2: The wettest weeks keep the riverbanks flooded and the bush muddy, so walking safaris stay closed.
months.7: Dry paths and sparse vegetation let guides lead walks safely along the bush and riverbanks.
months.8: Cool, dry days and open bush make long guided walks easy, with wildlife gathering near the river.
months.9: The dry season holds, with sparse vegetation and long sightlines for guided walks, though afternoons are getting hotter.

zimbabwe.overview: Walking here means guided walking safaris in the bush and easy, scenic strolls along the Zambezi River. Mana Pools and Hwange offer guided walks where visitors track wildlife on foot through the savanna. Around Victoria Falls, paved paths trace the gorge edge for views of the plunging water. Because of dangerous wildlife, all bush walks require an armed guide, and the best routes operate only during the dry months.

months.7: Excellent conditions for walking safaris continue. The dry terrain allows guides to lead safe walks through the bush, and the paths around the gorge offer clear views.
months.9: Heat builds rapidly, so guided bush walks start right at dawn. The extremely dry vegetation provides the best visibility for tracking on foot.

zion-bryce.overview: Zion and Bryce Canyon offer dramatic desert day hiking. In Zion, the exposed Angels Landing trail climbs a narrow sandstone fin (permit required), while the Narrows involves wading directly up the Virgin River through a slot canyon. Bryce Canyon provides a completely different landscape, with trails like the Navajo Loop descending into an amphitheater of bright orange hoodoos. Spring and fall offer the best weather, avoiding the extreme summer heat of Zion's canyon floor and the winter snows of Bryce's high rim.

months.2: Winter conditions persist, with Bryce keeping its snow cover and Zion offering chilly walking on lower trails.
months.7: Zion is very hot, so early starts are essential on exposed trails, and afternoon thunderstorms can bring flash flood risk to slot canyons.
months.10: Fall delivers perfect walking weather across both parks, with cool mornings and comfortable afternoons ideal for steep climbs and canyon wading.
